use_case_name: Share a Geographic Pointer with Other Units

claims.content: To enable C2 JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU displays using a J7.3 message.

goal.raw_text: To enable C2 JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU displays using a J7.3 message.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has the J7.3 message capability to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU displays.
The J7.3 message is addressed to one, multiple, or all IUs.
If the J7.3 message is addressed to one JU, the J7.3I Pointer initial word contains the specific address.
A C2 JU initiates a J7.3 message to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU displays.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU initiates a J7.3 message to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU displays.

claims.content: The C2 JU designates a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU's displays using a J7.3 message.
The J7.3 message is addressed to one, multiple, or all IUs.
When the J7.3 message is addressed to one JU, the J7.3I Pointer initial word contains the specific address.
In the absence of textual clarification, the J7.3 message is used in conjunction with voice communications.
1. If the J7.3 message is addressed to multiple JUs, the J7.3I word contains one address and the J7.3C1 Pointer Additional Addresses continuation word can contain up to four additional addresses.
2. Multiple J7.3C1 words can be sent to accommodate more than five addresses.
3. When the J7.3 message is addressed to all JUs, the J7.3I word contains the collective address.
4. The J7.3 message can be used to specify one or more operator positions by function within a JU through the use of the pointer action data element.
5. There is no TN assigned to the pointer; therefore, it must be displayed and dropped by local procedure.
A J7.3 message provides the capability for C2 JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C2 JU's displays.
The J7.3 message can be addressed to one, multiple, or all IUs.
If the J7.3 message is addressed to one JU, the J7.3I Pointer initial word contains the specific address.

When the J7.3 message is addressed to multiple JUs, the J7.3I word contains one address and the J7.3C1 Pointer Additional Addresses continuation word can contain up to four additional addresses; multiple J7.3C1 words can be sent to accommodate more than five addresses.
When the J7.3 message is addressed to all JUs, the J7.3I word contains the collective address.
The J7.3C2 and J7.3C3 words are used to provide amplifying textual information of up to twenty characters.
There is no TN assigned to the pointer; therefore, it must be displayed and dropped by local procedure.
